desc:
[BETA RELEASE]

In this town, there are rules. Break one and find out....

Every match, one player is the Mayor. They write the town's story: the rules everyone must follow for the night and add the twist! 

☀️ BY DAY: Breaking the rules results in funny scenarios 

🌙 BY NIGHT the rules are deadly. Break one and you're MARKED. Mr. Tock hunts the marked. Hide, sprint, stun him, and pull your friends free.

👻 Get caught? You come back as a shadow and help Mr.Tock

🃏 Collect 39 twist cards to use as Mayor

Survive until dawn. Win back the Town.

5 town maps more to come
